sentences.tgt: Elle:o prit:v de:o petites:a bouchées:n ,:o d':o abord:a d':o un:o morceau:n et:o ensuite:a de:o l':o autre:a morceau:n .:o

sentences.en: One little bite made her grow, and the next little bite made her shrink.
sentences.tgt: Une:o petite:a bouchée:n la:o fit:v grandir:v ,:o et:o la:o bouchée:n suivante:a la:o fit:v rétrécir:v .:o

sentences.en: At last Alice stood at her own right size in the wood again.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o se:o retrouva:v enfin:a à:o sa:o propre:a taille:n dans:o le:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: The grow piece went into her right pocket, the shrink piece into her left.
sentences.tgt: Le:o morceau:n pour:o grandir:v alla:v dans:o sa:o poche:n droite:a ,:o le:o morceau:n pour:o rétrécir:v dans:o sa:o gauche:a .:o

sentences.en: Alice was curious about the little house far off in the wood.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o était:v curieuse:a au:o sujet:n de:o la:o petite:a maison:n loin:a dans:o le:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: She went on through the green trees with a piece in each pocket.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o continua:v à:o travers:o les:o arbres:n verts:a avec:o un:o morceau:n dans:o chaque:o poche:n .:o

sentences.en: The road went on under the trees.
sentences.tgt: La:o route:n continuait:v sous:o les:o arbres:n .:o

sentences.en: As Alice walked, a smile appeared in the air over the road.
sentences.tgt: Tandis:o qu':o Alice:o marchait:v ,:o un:o sourire:n apparut:v dans:o l':o air:n au-dessus:o de:o la:o route:n .:o

sentences.en: It was a wide smile, and there was no cat around it.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o large:a sourire:n ,:o et:o il:o n':o y:o avait:v pas:o de:o chat:n autour:o .:o

sentences.en: Around the smile, a cat appeared, a little at a time.
sentences.tgt: Autour:o du:o sourire:n ,:o un:o chat:n apparut:v ,:o peu:a à:o peu:a .:o

sentences.en: First came the head of the cat, and after that the rest of it.
sentences.tgt: D':o abord:a vint:v la:o tête:n du:o chat:n ,:o et:o après:o cela:o le:o reste:n de:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Soon a big cat sat in the tree over the road, and it smiled down at Alice.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a un:o grand:a chat:n s':o installa:v dans:o l':o arbre:n au-dessus:a de:o la:o route:n ,:o et:o il:o sourit:v à:o Alice:o .:o

sentences.en: "Which is the right way to go?" Alice asked the cat.
sentences.tgt: «:o Quel:o est:v le:o bon:a chemin:n ?:o »:o Alice:o demanda:v au:o chat:n .:o

sentences.en: "Where do you want to go?" the cat asked in a soft voice.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o voulez-vous:v aller:v ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o chat:n d':o une:o voix:n douce:a .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know," said Alice.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Alice:o .:o

sentences.en: "If you do not know, any road will do," said the cat.
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o vous:o ne:o savez:v pas:o ,:o n':o importe:v quel:o chemin:n fera:v l':o affaire:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o chat:n .:o

sentences.en: "That way lives a hatter," it said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Par:o là:a habite:v un:o chapelier:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "The other way lives a hare."
sentences.tgt: «:o De:o l':o autre:a côté:n habite:v un:o lièvre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "They are both strange," the cat said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o sont:v tous:o les:o deux:o étranges:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o chat:n .:o

sentences.en: Alice wanted to see the hare, so she took that road.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o voulait:v voir:v le:o lièvre:n ,:o alors:o elle:o prit:v ce:o chemin:n -là:o .:o

sentences.en: When Alice looked back, the cat faded away, a little at a time.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o Alice:o regarda:v en:o arrière:a ,:o le:o chat:n disparut:v peu:a à:o peu:a .:o

sentences.en: Its tail went first, and after that the rest of it.
sentences.tgt: Sa:o queue:n disparut:v en:o premier:a ,:o et:o après:o cela:o le:o reste:n de:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: At last only the wide smile hung in the air over the road.
sentences.tgt: À:o la:o fin:n ,:o seul:a le:o large:a sourire:n resta:v suspendu:a dans:o l':o air:n au-dessus:o de:o la:o route:n .:o

sentences.en: The smile hung there alone for a time, and after that it faded away too.
sentences.tgt: Le:o sourire:n resta:v là:a seul:a pendant:o un:o moment:n ,:o et:o après:o cela:o il:o s':o effaça:v aussi:a .:o

sentences.chapter: The Tea Party That Never Ended
sentences.en: Soon Alice came to the little house, and before it, under a tree, stood a long table.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a Alice:o arriva:v à:o la:o petite:a maison:n ,:o et:o devant:o elle:o ,:o sous:o un:o arbre:n ,:o se:o trouvait:v une:o longue:a table:n .:o

sentences.en: Cups and cups stood all down the long table.
sentences.tgt: Des:o tasses:n et:o des:o tasses:n s':o alignaient:v tout:a le:o long:n de:o la:o grande:a table:n .:o

sentences.en: The hatter and the hare sat at one end, and a dormouse sat with them, fast asleep at the table.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chapelier:n et:o le:o lièvre:n s':o assirent:v à:o un:o bout:n ,:o et:o un:o loir:n s':o assit:v avec:o eux:o ,:o profondément:a endormi:a à:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: The hatter and the hare rested their arms on the dormouse and talked over its head.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chapelier:n et:o le:o lièvre:n posèrent:v leurs:o bras:n sur:o le:o loir:n et:o parlèrent:v par-dessus:o sa:o tête:n .:o

sentences.en: "No room at the table!" called the hare when it saw Alice.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o n':o y:o a:v pas:o de:o place:n à:o la:o table:n !:o »:o cria:v le:o lièvre:n quand:o il:o vit:v Alice:o .:o

sentences.en: "There is room for me," said Alice.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o y:o a:v de:o la:o place:n pour:o moi:o ,:o »:o dit:v Alice:o .:o

sentences.en: She sat down in a big chair at the end of the long table.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o s':o assit:v dans:o un:o grand:a fauteuil:n au:o bout:n de:o la:o longue:a table:n .:o

sentences.en: "What do a watch and a tea table both have?" the hatter asked her.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o est-ce:o qu':o une:o montre:n et:o une:o table:n à:o thé:n ont:v en:o commun:a ?:o »:o lui:o demanda:v le:o chapelier:n .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know," said Alice at last.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Alice:o à:o la:o fin:n .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know it at all," said the hatter.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o le:o sais:v pas:o du:o tout:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o chapelier:n .:o

sentences.en: The hatter took out a watch and looked at it for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chapelier:n sortit:v une:o montre:n et:o la:o regarda:v pendant:o longtemps:a .:o

sentences.en: "It is six, and it is always six," said the hatter.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v six:o heures:n ,:o et:o il:o est:v toujours:a six:o heures:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o chapelier:n .:o

sentences.en: "Six is tea time, so it is always tea time at this table."
sentences.tgt: «:o Six:o heures:n ,:o c':o est:v l':o heure:n du:o thé:n ,:o donc:o il:o est:v toujours:a l':o heure:n du:o thé:n à:o cette:o table:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "We drink tea all day," said the hare.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o buvons:v du:o thé:n toute:o la:o journée:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o lièvre:n .:o

sentences.en: When a cup was dirty, they all moved one chair down the table.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o une:o tasse:n était:v sale:a ,:o ils:o se:o déplaçaient:v tous:o d':o une:o chaise:n vers:o le:o bas:n de:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: Alice got no tea at all at the tea party.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o n':o eut:v pas:o de:o thé:n du:o tout:o à:o la:o fête:n du:o thé:n .:o

sentences.en: "This is the strangest tea party I have ever seen," said Alice, and she got up.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v la:o fête:n du:o thé:n la:o plus:a étrange:a que:o j':o aie:v jamais:o vue:v ,:o »:o dit:v Alice:o ,:o et:o elle:o se:o leva:v .:o

sentences.en: She walked away from the table and did not look back at it.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o s':o éloigna:v de:o la:o table:n et:o ne:o regarda:v pas:o en:o arrière:a .:o

sentences.en: Behind her, the hatter and the hare only moved down one more chair.
sentences.tgt: Derrière:o elle:o ,:o le:o chapelier:n et:o le:o lièvre:n ne:o se:o déplacèrent:v que:o d':o une:o chaise:n de:o plus:a .:o

sentences.en: Alice walked on from the tea party into the wood.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o continua:v depuis:o la:o fête:n du:o thé:n jusqu':o au:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: One big tree had a little door in its side.
sentences.tgt: Un:o grand:a arbre:n avait:v une:o petite:a porte:n dans:o son:o flanc:n .:o

sentences.en: She opened the door in the tree and walked in.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o ouvrit:v la:o porte:n dans:o l':o arbre:n et:o entra:v .:o

sentences.en: In the tree there was no tree at all.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o l':o arbre:n ,:o il:o n':o y:o avait:v pas:o d':o arbre:n du:o tout:a .:o

sentences.en: Alice was back in the long hall!
sentences.tgt: Alice:o était:v de:o nouveau:a dans:o le:o long:a couloir:n !:o

sentences.en: The lamps still hung from the roof, and the glass table stood where it had stood before.
sentences.tgt: Les:o lampes:n pendaient:v encore:a au:o plafond:n ,:o et:o la:o table:n de:o verre:n était:v là:a où:o elle:o avait:v été:v avant:a .:o

sentences.en: The little gold key was still on the floor where it had fallen.
sentences.tgt: La:o petite:a clé:n en:o or:n était:v encore:a sur:o le:o sol:n là:a où:o elle:o était:v tombée:v .:o

sentences.en: This time, Alice knew what to do.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o fois:n ,:o Alice:o savait:v quoi:o faire:v .:o

sentences.en: She took the little gold key and went down on her knees at the little door.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o prit:v la:o petite:a clé:n en:o or:n et:o s':o agenouilla:v devant:o la:o petite:a porte:n .:o

sentences.en: Alice turned the gold key, and the little door opened once more.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o tourna:v la:o clé:n en:o or:n ,:o et:o la:o petite:a porte:n s':o ouvrit:v encore:a une:o fois:n .:o

sentences.en: Alice held the little door open with one hand.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o maintint:v la:o petite:a porte:n ouverte:a avec:o une:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: With the other hand, she took the little shrink piece from her left pocket.
sentences.tgt: De:o l':o autre:a main:n ,:o elle:o prit:v le:o petit:a morceau:n rétrécissant:a de:o sa:o poche:n gauche:a .:o

sentences.en: She bit it once and shrank, with her hand still on the open door.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o en:o mordit:v une:o fois:n et:o rétrécit:v ,:o avec:o sa:o main:n toujours:a sur:o la:o porte:n ouverte:a .:o

sentences.en: When the little door stood as high as her head, Alice walked through it into the garden.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o la:o petite:a porte:n fut:v aussi:a haute:a que:o sa:o tête:n ,:o Alice:o marcha:v à:o travers:o elle:o dans:o le:o jardin:n .:o

sentences.en: The bright flowers of the garden stood high over her head once more.
sentences.tgt: Les:o grandes:a fleurs:n du:o jardin:n s':o élevaient:v bien:a au-dessus:o de:o sa:o tête:n une:o fois:n de:o plus:o .:o

sentences.en: Alice took the grow piece from her right pocket and ate a little bite.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o prit:v le:o morceau:n de:o croissance:n de:o sa:o poche:n droite:a et:o en:o mangea:v une:o petite:a bouchée:n .:o

sentences.en: She grew back to her own right size there in the garden.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o retrouva:v sa:o propre:a taille:n normale:a là:a dans:o le:o jardin:n .:o

sentences.en: Not far down the garden, Alice came to a tree full of white roses.
sentences.tgt: Pas:o loin:a dans:o le:o jardin:n ,:o Alice:o arriva:v à:o un:o arbre:n plein:a de:o roses:n blanches:a .:o

sentences.en: Three gardeners stood at the tree, and they painted the white roses red.
sentences.tgt: Trois:o jardiniers:n se:o tenaient:v près:o de:o l':o arbre:n ,:o et:o ils:o peignaient:v les:o roses:n blanches:a en:o rouge:a .:o

sentences.en: But many of the roses on the tree were still all white.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o beaucoup:o de:o roses:n sur:o l':o arbre:n étaient:v encore:a toutes:a blanches:a .:o

sentences.en: "What is all the red for?" Alice asked the three gardeners at the tree.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:o tout:o ce:o rouge:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Alice:o aux:o trois:o jardiniers:n près:o de:o l':o arbre:n .:o

sentences.en: "We planted white roses by mistake, and the queen wanted red," said one gardener.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o avons:v planté:v des:o roses:n blanches:a par:o erreur:n ,:o et:o la:o reine:n voulait:v du:o rouge:n ,:o »:o dit:v un:o jardinier:n .:o

sentences.en: "If the queen sees white roses in her garden, she will have our heads cut off."
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o la:o reine:n voit:v des:o roses:n blanches:a dans:o son:o jardin:n ,:o elle:o nous:o fera:v couper:v la:o tête:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Alice heard a horn far away across the garden.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o entendit:v un:o cor:n loin:a là-bas:a à:o travers:o le:o jardin:n .:o

sentences.en: The gardeners heard it too and went down flat on their faces.
sentences.tgt: Les:o jardiniers:n l':o entendirent:v aussi:a et:o se:o jetèrent:v à:o plat:a sur:o leurs:o visages:n .:o

sentences.en: Soldiers marched into the garden of red and white roses, two by two.
sentences.tgt: Des:o soldats:n marchèrent:v dans:o le:o jardin:n de:o roses:n rouges:a et:o blanches:a ,:o deux:o par:o deux:o .:o

sentences.en: Each soldier was a card with two arms and two legs.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o soldat:n était:v une:o carte:n avec:o deux:o bras:n et:o deux:o jambes:n .:o

sentences.en: The cards were flat and white, with red hearts on them.
sentences.tgt: Les:o cartes:n étaient:v plates:a et:o blanches:a ,:o avec:o des:o cœurs:n rouges:a dessus:a .:o

sentences.en: After the card soldiers came the King and Queen of Hearts.
sentences.tgt: Après:o les:o soldats-cartes:n vinrent:v le:o Roi:o et:o la:o Reine:o de:o Cœur:o .:o

sentences.en: The Queen of Hearts stopped at the tree and looked at the white and red roses.
sentences.tgt: La:o Reine:o de:o Cœur:o s':o arrêta:v à:o l':o arbre:n et:o regarda:v les:o roses:n blanches:a et:o rouges:a .:o

sentences.en: "The roses are still white!" the queen shouted.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o roses:n sont:v encore:a blanches:a !:o »:o cria:v la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: "Off with their heads!" she shouted at the gardeners.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o on:o leur:o coupe:v la:o tête:n !:o »:o cria:v -t-elle:o aux:o jardiniers:n .:o

sentences.en: But the queen had turned away to the next tree of roses.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o la:o reine:n s':o était:v déjà:a détournée:v vers:o l':o arbre:n suivant:a des:o roses:n .:o

sentences.en: The gardeners ran to Alice, and the three flat cards went into a big garden pot by the tree.
sentences.tgt: Les:o jardiniers:n coururent:v vers:o Alice:o ,:o et:o les:o trois:o cartes:n plates:a allèrent:v dans:o un:o grand:a pot:n de:o jardin:n près:o de:o l':o arbre:n .:o

sentences.en: The soldiers looked for them but could not find them, and soon the queen went on down the garden.
sentences.tgt: Les:o soldats:n les:o cherchèrent:v mais:o ne:o purent:v pas:o les:o trouver:v ,:o et:o bientôt:a la:o reine:n continua:v plus:o loin:a dans:o le:o jardin:n .:o

sentences.en: "Can you play croquet?" the queen asked Alice.
sentences.tgt: «:o Savez-vous:v jouer:v au:o croquet:o ?:o »:o la:o reine:n demanda:v à:o Alice:o .:o

sentences.en: "I can," said Alice, and she walked after the queen to the croquet ground.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o le:o peux:v ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o ,:o et:o elle:o marcha:v après:o la:o reine:n jusqu':o au:o terrain:n de:o croquet:o .:o

sentences.en: The croquet ground had many players, and the queen and the king played too.
sentences.tgt: Le:o terrain:n de:o croquet:o avait:v beaucoup:a de:o joueurs:n ,:o et:o la:o reine:n et:o le:o roi:n jouèrent:v aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: Every ball and every hoop in the game could get up and walk.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o balle:n et:o chaque:o arceau:n dans:o le:o jeu:n pouvait:v se:o lever:v et:o marcher:v .:o

sentences.en: The balls of the game were hedgehogs, and each hedgehog was a ball.
sentences.tgt: Les:o balles:n du:o jeu:n étaient:v des:o hérissons:n ,:o et:o chaque:o hérisson:n était:v une:o balle:n .:o

sentences.en: The players hit the balls of the game with flamingos.
sentences.tgt: Les:o joueurs:n frappaient:v les:o balles:n du:o jeu:n avec:o des:o flamants:n .:o

sentences.en: Alice put the head of her flamingo down to the ground to hit her hedgehog.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o posa:v la:o tête:n de:o son:o flamant:n vers:o le:o bas:a pour:o frapper:v son:o hérisson:n .:o

sentences.en: But the flamingo turned its long neck up and looked at her.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o flamant:n tourna:v son:o long:a cou:n vers:o le:o haut:a et:o la:o regarda:v .:o

sentences.en: Alice laughed at it, and the flamingo would not go down any more.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o rit:v de:o lui:o ,:o et:o le:o flamant:n ne:o voulut:v pas:o descendre:v davantage:a .:o

sentences.en: When its head went down once more, her hedgehog had stood up and walked away.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o sa:o tête:n descendit:v encore:a une:o fois:n ,:o son:o hérisson:n s':o était:v levé:v et:o avait:v marché:v au:o loin:a .:o

sentences.en: The hoops of the game were card soldiers, down on their hands and feet.
sentences.tgt: Les:o arceaux:n du:o jeu:n étaient:v des:o soldats:n de:o cartes:n ,:o à:o quatre:o pattes:n .:o

sentences.en: When a ball came to them, the card soldiers stood up and walked away too.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o une:o balle:n arrivait:v vers:o eux:o ,:o les:o soldats:n de:o cartes:n se:o levaient:v et:o s':o en:o allaient:v aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: All the players played at once, and they took the hedgehogs from each other.
sentences.tgt: Tous:o les:o joueurs:n jouèrent:v en:o même:o temps:n ,:o et:o ils:o se:o prirent:v les:o hérissons:n les:o uns:o aux:o autres:o .:o

sentences.en: "Off with his head!" the queen shouted at one player, and at the next player after him.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o on:o lui:o coupe:v la:o tête:n !:o »:o cria:v la:o reine:n à:o un:o joueur:n ,:o et:o au:o joueur:n suivant:a après:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: But no head ever came off in the garden.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o aucune:o tête:n ne:o tomba:v jamais:o dans:o le:o jardin:n .:o

sentences.en: The king walked behind the queen and said to each player, "You are safe."
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n marcha:v derrière:o la:o reine:n et:o dit:v à:o chaque:o joueur:n ,:o «:o Vous:o êtes:v en:o sécurité:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The game was over when every hedgehog had walked away from the ground.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jeu:n était:v terminé:a quand:o chaque:o hérisson:n s':o était:v éloigné:v du:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: As the players stood still, the white rabbit ran in and held a horn up high.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o que:o les:o joueurs:n restaient:v immobiles:a ,:o le:o lapin:n blanc:a entra:v en:o courant:v et:o leva:v un:o cor:n bien:a haut:a .:o

sentences.en: All the cards went out of the garden after the rabbit.
sentences.tgt: Toutes:o les:o cartes:n sortirent:v du:o jardin:n derrière:o le:o lapin:n .:o

sentences.en: Alice went out of the garden after them.
sentences.tgt: Alice:o sortit:v du:o jardin:n derrière:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: The cards all went in two long rows to the court of the King and Queen of Hearts.

sentences.en: The king was the judge, and he had a white wig on his head.

sentences.en: Small animals sat in two rows at one side of the court that day.

sentences.en: They were the jury, and they wrote down all that they saw and heard.

sentences.en: In the court, before everyone, stood a little table full of the queen's tarts.

sentences.en: The Knave of Hearts stood before the high seats, with a card soldier on each side of him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Valet:n de:o Cœur:o se:o tenait:v devant:o les:o sièges:n élevés:a ,:o avec:o un:o soldat:n de:o carte:n de:o chaque:o côté:n de:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: With a long paper in his hand, the white rabbit called, "Quiet in the court!"

sentences.en: "The Queen of Hearts made the tarts on a hot day," read the rabbit from the paper.
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o Reine:n de:o Cœur:o a:v fait:v les:o tartes:n par:o une:o journée:n chaude:a ,:o »:o lut:v le:o lapin:n sur:o le:o papier:n .:o

sentences.en: "The Knave of Hearts stole the tarts and took them all far away from the court."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o Valet:n de:o Cœur:o a:v volé:v les:o tartes:n et:o les:o a:v emportées:v très:a loin:a de:o la:o cour:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I did not steal them!" said the Knave of Hearts to all the court.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o les:o ai:v pas:o volées:v !:o »:o dit:v le:o Valet:n de:o Cœur:o à:o toute:o la:o cour:n .:o

sentences.en: "The court will now hear the first witness," said the king on his high seat.
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o cour:n va:v maintenant:a entendre:v le:o premier:a témoin:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n sur:o son:o siège:n élevé:a .:o

sentences.en: The first witness of the day was the hatter, with a cup of hot tea in his hand.
sentences.tgt: Le:o premier:a témoin:n du:o jour:n était:v le:o chapelier:n ,:o avec:o une:o tasse:n de:o thé:n chaud:a à:o la:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: "I was not done with my tea," said the hatter.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o avais:v pas:o fini:v mon:o thé:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o chapelier:n .:o

sentences.en: "It is always tea time for me," he said to the king.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v toujours:a l':o heure:n du:o thé:n pour:o moi:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o au:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: "What do you know about the tarts?" the king asked the hatter from his high seat.
sentences.tgt: Que:o savez:v -vous:o des:o tartes:n ?:o demanda:v le:o roi:n au:o chapelier:n depuis:o son:o siège:n élevé:a .:o

sentences.en: "Nothing at all," said the hatter, and he looked down at his cup of tea.
sentences.tgt: «:o Rien:o du:o tout:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o chapelier:n ,:o et:o il:o baissa:v les:o yeux:n sur:o sa:o tasse:n de:o thé:n .:o

sentences.en: The hands of the hatter shook, and his tea ran over the edge of his cup.
sentences.tgt: Les:o mains:n du:o chapelier:n tremblèrent:v ,:o et:o son:o thé:n déborda:v du:o bord:n de:o sa:o tasse:n .:o

sentences.en: "You can go," said the king, and the hatter ran out of the court and far away.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o pouvez:v partir:v ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n ,:o et:o le:o chapelier:n courut:v hors:o du:o tribunal:n et:o très:a loin:a .:o

sentences.en: The white rabbit looked at the long paper again, and Alice was next on the paper.

sentences.en: Alice stood up, and everyone in the court looked at her at once.

sentences.en: "What do you know about the tarts?" the king asked her before all the court.
sentences.tgt: «:o Que:o savez:v -vous:o des:o tartes:n ?:o »:o lui:o demanda:v le:o roi:n devant:o tout:o le:o tribunal:n .:o

sentences.en: "Nothing at all about them," said Alice to the king.

sentences.en: "That is important," said the king to the jury.

sentences.en: "The king means it is not important," said the white rabbit, and he looked at the king.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o roi:n veut:v dire:v que:o ce:o n':o est:v pas:o important:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o lapin:n blanc:a ,:o et:o il:o regarda:v le:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: The small animals of the jury wrote down both of the words.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petits:a animaux:n du:o jury:n écrivirent:v les:o deux:o mots:n .:o

sentences.en: The white rabbit stood up again with one more paper in his hand.

sentences.en: "It is a poem about the tarts," said the rabbit to the court.

sentences.en: But the Knave of Hearts was not in the poem at all.

sentences.en: "This poem means nothing at all," said Alice to all the court.

sentences.en: "If it means nothing, we can all go home now," said the king.
sentences.tgt: «:o S':o il:o ne:o signifie:v rien:o ,:o nous:o pouvons:v tous:o rentrer:v chez:o nous:o maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: "The jury will now say the verdict," said the king, and the small animals of the jury stood up.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o jury:n va:v maintenant:a annoncer:v le:o verdict:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n ,:o et:o les:o petits:a animaux:n du:o jury:n se:o levèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: "No!" the queen shouted, and the court went quiet all at once.

sentences.en: "Punishment first, and the verdict after," said the queen to all the court.

sentences.en: "That is not right," said Alice, and she stood still.

sentences.en: "The punishment cannot come before the verdict," Alice said to the queen and the king.

sentences.en: "Off with her head!" the queen shouted at Alice, and the court went quiet again.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o on:o lui:o coupe:v la:o tête:n !:o »:o cria:v la:o reine:n à:o Alice:o ,:o et:o la:o cour:n devint:v silencieuse:a de:o nouveau:a .:o

sentences.en: Two rows of card soldiers marched at Alice to take hold of her.

sentences.en: Alice put her hand into her right pocket, and the last piece of the mushroom was still there.

sentences.en: Alice ate it all at once, and she began to grow and grow, up and up.

sentences.en: Alice grew and grew, up and up, before the high seats of the little court.

sentences.en: The card soldiers stopped where they stood, every one of them.

sentences.en: The small animals of the jury ran from their seats and away out of the court.

sentences.en: The white rabbit dropped his long paper and ran from the court.

sentences.en: "Off with her head!" the queen shouted up one more time at the giant Alice.

sentences.en: But not one card soldier moved a step.

sentences.en: "I am not afraid of you now," said Alice from high above them.

sentences.en: Her head was in her sister's lap, on the grass of the river bank.

sentences.en: The sky was blue over the river, and the evening sun was warm on the grass.

sentences.en: Alice and her sister got up from the grass and walked home over the field in the last light.

sentences.en: Alice ran over the grass after her sister, home to tea.
